pages.title: YunLai Swordmanship
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Swords$(br2)§lEffect: §r Boosts attack speed, reach, and damage; hits have a chance to launch a ranged sword-qi projectile.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with Ancient YunLai Swordmanship and other melee damage/growth enchantments.
